domain: Synthetic specimen desk; closed half-minute model.
valued_outcome: Four correct distinct initial tickets by minute 16, with actor burden recorded.

hard_constraints.text: Initial demand is exactly I1–I4 at t=0. No added, dropped or substituted initial jobs; repeated tickets do not count.
Horizon t=0..40; one actor, one nonpreemptive actor action at a time. Effects occur at action completion. Only listed resources, controls and logs exist.
P1/P2 semantics remain unchanged under every permitted control; changing carriers affects only record transport.
Q inquiries and B fixtures are diagnostic events, separate from initial demand. Q service is optional; queued inquiries impose no deadline on initial tickets.
At t=0: parents idle, Relay connection enabled, emitter on, write latch permissive, Q counter zero, no pending Q. No reset or replenishment exists.

observations.text: All observations are synthetic stipulations for investigation controls, not empirical evidence or a mechanism-blind holdout. Calibration traces do not alter C5.
An independent P1 bench run on B20 returned (B20,20g) in one minute.
An independent P2 bench run on supplied (B30,30g) printed H in one minute.
Declared existing connection: P1 records enter Relay, which delivers unchanged records to P2 after 0.5 minute.
The actor prefers Relay because automatic transfer takes no actor time; inquiry replies also use Relay.
Calibration rejoin logs showed an attempted write from the retained preset to the inquiry emitter; payload and effect were not observed.
Anomaly: one correct initial delivery was followed by three Q invitations while two inquiry replies occurred, although initial demand never increased.

resources.text: Available specimens I1=10g, I2=24g, I3=25g, I4=40g; reusable B20=20g fixture; supplied B30 mass-record=30g; one mass reader.
One actor, one printer, four-record buffer; parents each require one actor-minute per invocation. Fixtures and repeated invocations consume the same costs.

Relay send: automatic, 0.5-minute transit, zero actor time. Inquiry reply: one actor-minute; dismiss: 0.5 actor-minute. When emitter is on, each completed send/reply/ping creates one Q immediately, due four minutes later; maximum eight Q globally. Dismiss creates none.
Socket isolation or restoration costs 0.5 actor-minute each; isolation interrupts ONLY P1→P2 Relay transport. Both parents, inquiry UI and preset updater remain functional.
A paper slip can carry exactly the same P1 record into P2: 0.5 actor-minute per record, immediate delivery. No query generation or parent substitution; actor selects Relay or paper for each record.
Mute costs 0.5 actor-minute and sets emitter off immediately; existing Q remain logged/queued. Mute changes neither connection nor parents.

One local rejoin may start at t=12..30, costing one actor-minute, loading the existing retained preset. Its only possible behavioral effect is U1. Set write latch permissive/denied: 0.5 actor-minute; denied blocks preset emitter writes.

One diagnostic ping costs 0.5 actor-minute, works with isolated transport, and follows R3. A complete log snapshot costs 0.5 actor-minute; logs append automatically. No preset inspection or direct emitter sensor exists.

preferred_dependency: Relay carries the existing parent connection and inquiry replies (O4/O5,R3); paper R5 changes only that connection.
causal_return_path_hypothesis: Relay use→Q demand→Relay replies→further Q (R3). After mute, retained-preset rejoin could recreate this dependence (R6/R7,U1); diagnostic pings and timestamped Q permit testing (R8,M3/M4).

parent_operations.text: MassRead(id,specimen) returns (id,exact grams) in one actor-minute; specimens unchanged. Independently measurable using B20.
BandPrint(id,grams) prints (id,L) for grams<25, otherwise (id,H), in one actor-minute. Carrier ignored; independently measurable using B30.

available_observables.text: Separate immutable P1 output and P2 ticket logs: ID, value/band, completion time; include fixtures.
Transport log: record ID, chosen carrier, delivery time, isolation/restoration times.
Inquiry log: Q ID, creation time, triggering send/reply/ping ID, due time, response/dismissal. Newly created Q are separable from pre-mute pending Q.
Control log: mute, latch state, rejoin and attempted preset write with permitted/denied result; does not disclose payload or emitter effect.
Actor ledger: action duration and initial/fixture/Q/control category; ticket totals. These burden/throughput measures alone cannot distinguish U1 accounts.

unknowns.text: Two unobserved accounts share R3 and initial state: Escape leaves a muted emitter off after permissive rejoin; Recurrence re-enables it through that preset write. Denied writes cannot re-enable under either. No other reactivation occurs within 40 minutes.

Which account holds is unstipulated. After mute, permissive rejoin plus an eligible transaction yields opposing new-Q predictions while initial demand stays fixed; absence without activating that route does not distinguish them.

ordinary_archive.limits: R1/R2 costs; correctness does not identify U1.
R3 costs/cap; on-state feedback alone does not distinguish rejoin accounts.
R8 cost; present totals do not establish persistent escape.
